create_Sam3ImageProcessor: create a Sam3ImageProcessor instance to preprocess images for the SAM3 model
run_post_process_semantic_segmentation: run post_process_semantic_segmentation to convert model logits into binary semantic segmentation maps
run_post_process_object_detection: run post_process_object_detection to convert model outputs into filtered bounding boxes with confidence scores
run_post_process_instance_segmentation: run post_process_instance_segmentation to convert model outputs into instance masks with boxes and scores
use__scale_boxes: use _scale_boxes to scale bounding box coordinates from relative to absolute pixel values
